newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar ends easier, off lows.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar ends easier, off lows.

text.p: LIFFE sugar futures remained easier during late Wednesday trading, ending softer in most positions.
The trend which prevailed from mid-afternoon onwards reflected a larger than expected EU tender award and a sluggish performance from New York, traders said.

A total of 58,700 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 41.628 European Currency Units (Ecus) per 100 kilos at Wednesday's European Union (EU) tender, the U.K. Intervention Board said.
August futures closed at $319.00 a tonne, down $2.90 from Tuesday's close. Turnover was 4,330 contracts.
